# Wipe › Shape Mask

**What belongs here.** B appears through a growing designed shape.

**Examples.** logo reveal, letterform mask

**Family test.** Is there an edge with A on one side and B on the other, travelling until B fills the frame?

Each transition here has its own folder named by its id (lowercase, hyphens). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Transitions

| Transition | Summary |
|---|---|
| [Rounded Reveal](rounded-reveal/) | The new scene opens in a rounded window that grows from the centre to full frame, settling from a slight zoom inside. |
| [Text Mask Zoom](text-mask/) | A word appears with the new scene inside its letters, then zooms through one letter until the new scene fills the frame. |
